Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework

Interface IFrameworkGatewayView

public interface IFrameworkGatewayView
Internal gateway contract used by framework handle implementations.

This type is not part of the supported public API surface and exists to decouple public handle types from implementation classes in framework.internal.
